//note: Two independent analysis passes run the same prompt template against the same implementation, then a consensus stage extracts agreement and flags divergent findings for human triage.

pipeline.title: Independent Review Pass A
pipeline.spec: You are an independent reviewer (pass A). Audit the implementation produced by the {reads} stage against the harness constitution and the Rational Persuasion contract. Report findings as P0/P1/P2 with file paths and evidence. Write the report to {out}. Do not read any other review output; this pass must stay independent.

pipeline.title: Independent Review Pass B
pipeline.spec: You are an independent reviewer (pass B). Audit the implementation produced by the {reads} stage against the harness constitution and the Rational Persuasion contract. Report findings as P0/P1/P2 with file paths and evidence. Write the report to {out}. Do not read any other review output; this pass must stay independent.

pipeline.title: Consensus Extraction
pipeline.spec: You are the Consensus Extractor. Read both independent reviews in {reads}. Merge findings both passes agree on into one verdict. Divergent findings must not be resolved by you: flag each one for human triage, quoting both positions. Write the result to {out}.
